boundary_mode_analysis.documented_contract: Boundary Mode Analysis uses beta_i=j*lambda and neff_i=beta_i/k0; this is the BMA relation, not ordinary Mode Analysis beta=imag(alpha).

solution_info.documented_contract: getPNames/getPvals/getPvalsImag/getUnits accept one-based solnums where each solnums[n] is an (outer,inner) tuple; doc example maps (2,4) to return entry 5. getSolnum(outer,true) returns one-based inner solution numbers or an empty array when strict and the outer index is invalid. getOuterSolnum returns an empty array if there are no outer parameters/values. getSol and getSolverSequence accept a one-based outer solution number.

solver_sequence_parameter_values.documented_contract: getPVals(int solnum) exposes actual stored parameter tuples, time values, or real eigenvalues according to the solution sequence; getPValsImag(int solnum) exposes imaginary values. Activity010 records exact getter identity and raw return for the observed inner solnum but does not infer which semantic axis the values represent.
solver_sequence_parameter_values.installed_javap: COMSOL 6.4.0.293 SolverSequence declares getPNames() -> String[], getPVals(int) -> double[], and getPValsImag(int) -> double[].

solver_sequence_type_and_parameter_value.documented_contract: getSequenceType() classifies actual sequence types including SolverSequence, CopySolution, ParametricStore, and Stored. getPNames() returns the sequence parameter names; getPVals(solnum) and getPValsImag(solnum) return actual stored real/imaginary parameter values for the requested solution index. Preserve returned names/values without assigning a frequency, wavelength, time, or eigenvalue role.
